name: Three-Section Test-Class Criterion
statement: For $H_T=(T\times\{00\})\cup(\{0,1\}^Y\times\{01\})\cup(T^{\mathrm c}\times\{11\})$, the test $T$ belongs to $\mathcal U_Y$ exactly when $H_T\in\mathsf{MaxMin}$.
hypotheses: Finite binary test, including the full-cube constant; the empty constant is admitted in the source's enlarged family.
